edges.reason: Context._msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the balance move.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance lookup.
transfer delegates state mutation to internal _transfer.
approve delegates allowance writing to internal _approve.
transferFrom delegates the balance move to internal _transfer.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance through internal _approve.
transferFrom reads and rewrites the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom stores _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] into currentAllowance.
transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount, an arithmetic operation gated by a require.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the existing allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_transfer loads _balances[sender] into the senderBalance local.
_approve writes the amount into _allowances[owner][spender].
_mint credits the minted amount to _balances[account].
_mint increases the tracked total supply.
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount, an unchecked-boundary arithmetic update.
_burn debits the burned amount from _balances[account].
_burn decreases the tracked total supply.
balanceOf returns the value stored in _balances.
allowance returns the nested _allowances entry.
totalSupply returns the stored _totalSupply.
SimpleERC20 constructor calls internal _mint for the initial supply.
Constructor validates and uses initialBalance_ as the minted amount.
Constructor mints the entire initial supply to the caller-derived msg.sender.
Constructor forwards feeReceiver_ to the ServicePayer base constructor.
ServicePayer constructor performs an external payable call to the receiver contract, allowing arbitrary code execution during deployment.
serviceName parameter is passed into the external pay call.
transfer binds its recipient address parameter.
transfer binds its amount parameter.
approve binds its spender address parameter.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter is only meaningful inside transfer and should be collapsed into the transfer function core node.
The amount parameter is a local binding of transfer and carries no standalone semantics.
The spender parameter is only used by approve and should be merged into the approve function node.
The currentAllowance local is a temporary copy of _allowances produced inside transferFrom.
The senderBalance local is a temporary snapshot of _balances created inside _transfer.
The initialBalance_ parameter is only consumed by the constructor to mint the initial supply.
The serviceName parameter is only forwarded into the constructor's external pay call.
The feeReceiver_ parameter is only used by the constructor to configure the ServicePayer base.
